text:
Marla: Morning! non-work drop — Mavis (my ferret) learned to march across my pillow fort this morning. video uploaded :camera_flash: https://imgur.com/a/placeholder
Diego: omg icon. she looks so proud :heart_eyes:
Sam: that tiny parade is the energy i need for monday 
Anya: Is this a training montage? do you have a tutorial? :laughing:
Marla: no tutorial yet. 3-step method: bribe with sunflower seeds, soft encouragement, brib... i mean reinforcement :seedling:
Kevin: Background question: ferret or pillow theft?
Marla: both. equal parts thief & performer.
Nora: Vote: should we have "bring your pet pillow" day at the next remote hangout? :raised_hands:
Diego: +1 from me, also i will bring my cat and two suspicious socks
Sam: +1, will make a mini obstacle course for pets, will test with a stuffed hedgehog first :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Anya: +1 — also, Marla, can you make a 10s boomerang of the march? for posterity.
Marla: yes will drop a boomerang after lunch :camera_with_flash:
cam-bot: uploaded an image: mavis-march-boomerang.gif (file)
